It is illustrative, not an explicit prescribed cloud-visualization exercise or a validated colour score. Strong new thoughts/I am are offered as alleged neutralization.

records.normalizedEnglish: The author recommends maintaining confident I can and I will/want thinking, trying it with expectation, and avoiding hatred/envy, while asserting similar thought waves attract and return amplified. The wave/attraction mechanism and guaranteed benefits are not demonstrated. These continue earlier can/will advice rather than supply a separately numbered drill.
